findings.title: Solver rule model (rules.mjs) has no drift guard against index.html
findings.failure_scenario: index.html's canStackTableau/tailDir/maxMovable/isSeqHead is edited; rules.mjs keeps old logic; certifications now use stale rules while all tests stay green.
findings.rationale: The tableau-move rules live only in index.html and rules.mjs; the existing drift guard covers engine.mjs only (which doesn't contain them). The feature's single trust anchor is unenforced. Currently identical (verified).
findings.suggested_fix: Extend a drift guard to assert isSeqHead/canStackTableau/tailDir/runDir/maxMovable bodies still appear verbatim in index.html.

status_history.validation: 11 rule bodies pinned verbatim in current index.html; covers tailDir no-reverse + maxMovable; plausible edits trip it. FIXED.

findings.title: Frozen history depends on unguarded code constants, not just the pool
findings.failure_scenario: A future edit adds/reorders GOLD or SILVER_CERTIFIED; goldPool/silverPool indices shift; rng()*len reshuffles every past day's gold/silver; all tests still pass.
findings.rationale: dailyChallenge depends on (dayIndex, pool, objective-array ordering, rng seed). Tests only append to a fake pool and never pin real (dayIndex->objectiveId) vectors.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a golden-master test pinning several (dayIndex, real-pool-slice)->{silverId,goldId}; freeze/version the objective arrays.

status_history.validation: golden values match code, non-tautological; silver picks at indices 0/1/3 catch reorders/rng change; append-only tested. FIXED.

findings.title: par is inadmissible and overstates the optimum; moves cap runs loose
findings.failure_scenario: seed 10007: reference par=88 but aces-first par=76 (a legal unconstrained line); moves cap=106 granted when 76 achievable.
findings.rationale: f=g+2h inadmissible; constrained sub-searches beat the reference par. Deterministic so frozen history safe, but calibration loose; 'reference par' a misnomer.
findings.suggested_fix: Store par = min(base_par, min constraintPar) in certify (still deterministic), so the moves cap tightens.

status_history.validation: par=min over fixed CERTIFIED; constraintPar numeric-only (no NaN); valid witness; docs updated. FIXED.

findings.title: Checkers trust pre-digested telemetry; no re-simulation vs the seed
findings.failure_scenario: A telemetry bug or edited localStorage logs wrong end/order or truncates foundationOrder; a checker grants the wrong tier; streaks corrupt. Confirmed kings-first with ace-down-before-kings passes (prefix/ace-up-only guard).
findings.rationale: evaluate consumes telemetry as ground truth, never validating legality for the seed. Local single-player (no server); the only 'adversary' is the user editing their own storage.
findings.suggested_fix: Add light structural invariants (well-formed foundationOrder) and/or document the trusted-telemetry contract; full re-simulation is likely over-engineering for a local personal game — use judgment.

status_history.validation: checkers verified to mirror solver gates exactly (only ace-up gated; ace-down/non-ace early allowed by both); tightening would break parity. Decline accepted. DISPUTED.

findings.title: Dead/unused outputs: cloneState and constraintPar
findings.failure_scenario: No functional failure; cost with no consumer.
findings.rationale: cloneState exported but unused; constraintPar stored but never read (moves cap uses base par).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete cloneState; and either consume constraintPar (F3) or drop it.

status_history.validation: cloneState deleted, unreferenced; constraintPar now read by F3. FIXED.

findings.title: Silver+gold may be jointly infeasible on one attempt (suspected)
findings.failure_scenario: silver='moves' cap paired with a gold whose cheapest line exceeds the cap => no single attempt earns both.
findings.rationale: evaluateChallenge grades both from one telemetry. Per the design, retries are free and the DailyStore keeps best-of per tier across attempts, so silver & gold need NOT co-occur on one attempt — likely a non-issue once aggregation is best-of. No concrete failing day found.
findings.suggested_fix: Document/enforce that per-day tiers are OR-accumulated across attempts (silver and gold independent); add a helper mergeTiers; optionally a pool sanity check.

status_history.validation: mergeTiers correct in isolation (OR tiers, min metrics, undefined-prev guarded). FIXED (but composition gap -> F7).

findings.title: evaluateChallenge output lacks moves/elapsed that mergeTiers consumes
findings.failure_scenario: web/iOS wire evaluateChallenge(...) into mergeTiers; attempt.moves/elapsed undefined; ?? Infinity keeps the day's moves/elapsed Infinity forever -> best-moves/best-time never records.
findings.rationale: evaluateChallenge returns {bronze,silver,gold} only; mergeTiers reads attempt.moves/elapsed; no test exercises the composition.
findings.suggested_fix: evaluateChallenge echoes moves/elapsed from telemetry (or mergeTiers takes telemetry); add a composition test.

status_history.validation: evaluateChallenge echoes {moves,elapsed} on win, omits on loss; composition test added; 51/51. FIXED.
